vpl.name: Lliurament Pr05 - Ejercicios de Estructuras Condicionales (I) (ENTREGAS RETRASADAS)

execution_file.name: execution_files/vpl_evaluate.sh
execution_file.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Compilación del código Java con codificación UTF-8 echo "Compiling the code..." javac -encoding UTF-8 Practica05.java if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Compilation Error" exit 1 fi
grade=0 max_grade=100
# Definir los puntos por prueba para totalizar 100 declare -A points_per_test points_per_test["1"]=15 # Ejercicio 1 points_per_test["2"]=14 # Ejercicio 2 points_per_test["3"]=14 # Ejercicio 3 points_per_test["4a"]=14 # Ejercicio 4 (horas < 40) points_per_test["4b"]=14 # Ejercicio 4 (horas = 40) points_per_test["4c"]=14 # Ejercicio 4 (horas > 40) points_per_test["5"]=15 # Ejercicio 5
# Función para ejecutar un caso de prueba run_test() { test_number="$1" test_input="$2" expected_output="$3"
echo "Running Test $test_number..." # Ejecutar el programa y capturar la salida output=$(echo -e "$test_input" | java -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 Practica05)
# Comparar la salida con la salida esperada if [ "$output" = "$expected_output" ]; then echo "Test $test_number Passed" grade=$((grade + points_per_test["$test_number"])) else echo "Test $test_number Failed" echo "Input:" echo -e "$test_input" echo "Expected Output:" echo -e "$expected_output" echo "Actual Output:" echo -e "$output" fi }
# Caso de prueba 1: Ejercicio 1 - SubjectOfTheDay test1_input="1\nMonday" test1_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter a day of the week: The first subject of the day is PROG." # test1_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter a day of the week: The first subject of the day is HTML."
run_test "1" "$test1_input" "$test1_expected_output"
# Caso de prueba 2: Ejercicio 2 - Greetings test2_input="2\n22" test2_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter the hour: Good evening"
run_test "2" "$test2_input" "$test2_expected_output"
# Caso de prueba 3: Ejercicio 3 - DaysOfWeek test3_input="3\n6" test3_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter a number (1-7): The corresponding day is Saturday."
run_test "3" "$test3_input" "$test3_expected_output"
# Ejercicio 4 - Overtime (casos adicionales)
# Caso de prueba 4a: Horas trabajadas menos de 40 test4a_input="4\n35" test4a_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter the number of hours worked: The total weekly wage is 350."
run_test "4a" "$test4a_input" "$test4a_expected_output"
# Caso de prueba 4b: Horas trabajadas exactamente 40 test4b_input="4\n40" test4b_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter the number of hours worked: The total weekly wage is 400."
run_test "4b" "$test4b_input" "$test4b_expected_output"
# Caso de prueba 4c: Horas trabajadas más de 40 test4c_input="4\n45" test4c_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter the number of hours worked: The total weekly wage is 460."
run_test "4c" "$test4c_input" "$test4c_expected_output"
# Caso de prueba 5: Ejercicio 5 - Horoscope test5_input="5\n15\nMay" test5_expected_output="Please select an exercise (1-5): Enter the day of birth: Enter the month of birth: Your horoscope is Taurus."
run_test "5" "$test5_input" "$test5_expected_output"
# Mostrar la calificación final echo "Total Grade: $grade/$max_grade"
# Salir con un código de estado que representa la calificación exit $((max_grade - grade))
